review_mode: Automated PPG-only candidate-indicator review; human reference validation unavailable
random_sampling: One20-second window wholly inside each120-second recording quarter; all30 recordings;120 windows
case_enrichment: Add the20 seconds ending one sample before each of the14 eligible original onsets, irrespective of any warning result; source linkage coordinator-only
reference_subset: Two nonoverlapping windows per recording: lowest and highest candidate-flag burden, deterministic WindowID ties;60 windows prioritized, not manually reviewed
filter: Existing forward-only Butterworth prototype3, bandpass0.5–5Hz, three SOS (digital order6), zero state at original record start; never restart at review-window boundary
detector: Existing PulseDetector unchanged: local max confirmed next sample; past-trough amplitude>=0.03; accepted-peak spacing>=0.30s; feature rows emitted only for paired intervals<=2s
review_landmark: Plausible systolic pulse corresponding to a maximum on the causal filtered waveform, corroborated against raw morphology; not an ECG R peak
matching_rationale: Ten125Hz samples; allows landmark annotation uncertainty while remaining below half the detector's300ms minimum spacing; fixed engineering tolerance, not a clinical standard
matching_method: One-to-one ordered matching maximizing count then minimizing total absolute peak-time error; compare peak times, not confirmation times
flat_rationale: At least100ms of identical exported samples, about a third of the fastest supported interval; descriptive candidate only, may be diastolic/quantization behavior
plateau_rationale: At least three equal consecutive samples at window min/max; candidate plateau, not verified clipping or a known ADC rail
abrupt_difference_rule: Absolute first difference > median+10*1.4826*MAD; unavailable when MAD is zero; robust relative candidate rule, not validated SQI
missing_detection_candidate: No accepted peaks or an internal accepted-peak gap>2s; edge gaps separately censored/descriptive
automated_freeze: Freeze pure-PPG summary, detector records, packet identities, source/plan hashes BEFORE joining warning/event metadata for exploratory automated associations
manual_freeze: No manual unblinding unless final annotations and matching/scoring plan are hash-sealed; only reviewer_packet is shared with a future reviewer
bootstrap: Reference evaluation only if annotations exist:2000 whole-pseudonymous-recording draws, seed2026102703; keep each record's windows together; evaluate each reviewer separately
feature_impact_gate: Only after manually verified exhaustive pulse corrections; otherwise unavailable. No synthetic corrections, model refits, threshold changes or historical feature substitution
known_blinding_limit: Coordinator/assistant knows prior results; only reviewer packet is outcome-masked. This is not a completed blinded human review
